placements.why: Establishes the organizational domain category covering memory ingestion flows, fallback mechanisms, and file commit handling.
placements.title: Ingestion and identifier resolution pipelines
placements.frame: How does the system process submitted memories and ensure resilient identifier generation and commit handling?

placements.title: Resilient identifier generation via LLM generation with deterministic slugify fallback
placements.frame: How should ingestion pipelines derive identifiers and ensure file commits when explicit IDs are omitted?
placements.why: Captures the operational requirement that submissions lacking an explicit ID must resolve to a valid slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback and commit successfully.
